name: Determine Action
set x_minutes
How this Sub Flow Works
info:
This Sub Flow is meant to turn entiries Off and also log an entry for each entity that it turns off.

It will evaluate entities that are groups and only log entries for theose entities that are currently on and being turned off

The reason that appears in the log entry, is populated by the Determine Action function

This Sub-Flow will take the given values...

1. SENSOR: motion/occupancy sensor enyity
    Required
2. ENTITY: entity to turn off
    Required
3. MIN_SEC_ABSENCE: Min time of absence - seconds
    default 0
4. MIN_SEC_ON: Min Time device has been on - seconds
    default 0
5. PRESENCE: Calculation Method (LONGEST, LAST, TOTAL, AVG) for amount of time of presence
    default LONGEST
6. OVER_X_MINUTES: Amount of time in minutes that history of occupancy should be evaluated
    default 10
7. IS_DARK_LUX: Lux (number)
    if 0 this is ignored
    default 0
8. DEBUG (true/false) determines if the debug log will be shown the logic behind this sub flow
    default false

Then decide if it should be turned off
If an entity was turned on manually then the values for MIN_SEC_ON & MIN_SEC_ABSENCE will be doubled and at a minumum of 10 minutes if not set

results...

msg.action is the action that has been taken on the entity (leave, off)
msg.descr is a description of what is being done and why
msg.SecondsSinceOccupancy = sense sime the room was last occupied
msg.SecondsOfOccupancy = total time of occupancy based on the calcualtion method (LONGEST, LAST, TOTAL, AVG)
msg.reason = a reason why action = leave

name: Recursively Expand Groups
Completion Check
Determine Action
